summary: Bind MCP DSL to the exact allowed project

delivery.outcome: Prevent explicit MCP DSL requests from selecting an ancestor or symlinked external ticket store; publish and verify the fix.

architecture.decision: Bind the MCP executor to an initialized exact project and reject escaping store paths before any read or write. Session continuation authorizes this bounded prerequisite of project-scoped registration.
interfaceChanges: Optional discover_project keyword defaults to existing CLI auto-discovery; MCP disables it.
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected PR without deleting stores.

validation.evidence: Parent/child read and mutation isolation and symlink regressions.
Existing MCP behavior and explicit uninitialized project handling.
